_comment: Defaults for the Claude Code send gate. A project overrides register, sender_owner, max_unanswered, crm_path and example_pages in <project>/.gates/config.json. It can only add to blocked_tools and banned_phrases. source_allowlist is read only from ~/.config/outbound-gates/config.json. blocked_tools holds the send tools of other channels (Apollo, Slack), matched by the part of the name after the last '__'. See docs/send-gate.md. send_words and deny_rules feed gates/setup.py: deny_rules lists per-server tool names written as project deny rules (Apollo's come from the apollo_ names in blocked_tools); send_words are matched by the user-level guard on any server.
